aircraft.name: F-16 Fighting Falcon
aircraft.summary: Single-engine multirole fighter with a side-stick and a fly-by-wire flight control system; the HOTAS layout of the C/D model is the reference most simulator HOTAS copy.

variants.name: F-16C Block 50/52

controls.name: Weapon Release button
controls.where: red button, top left of the grip, thumb

functions.text: Fire A-A missile / release A-G weapon (hold)

controls.name: Trim switch
controls.where: 4-way hat on top of the grip, centre

controls.name: Trigger
controls.where: two-detent trigger on the front of the grip, index finger

functions.text: Fire gun; CCIP: laser for 30 s

controls.name: Missile Step button (NWS / A/R DISC / MSL STEP)
controls.where: button on the front-left of the grip, below the trigger

functions.text: Next missile station of the type

controls.name: Target Management Switch (TMS)
controls.where: 4-way hat, top right of the grip head, thumb

controls.name: Display Management Switch (DMS)
controls.where: 4-way hat, left side of the grip head, thumb

controls.name: Countermeasures Management Switch (CMS)
controls.where: 4-way switch, lower right of the grip head, thumb

controls.name: Paddle switch
controls.where: lever on the lower front of the grip, little finger

functions.text: Autopilot off while held; new ref on release

controls.name: Expand/FOV button
controls.where: button on the lower rear of the grip, little finger

controls.name: Side Stick Controller (force sensing)
controls.where: right console; barely moves, the FLCS reads the force

controls.name: UHF VHF Transmit switch
controls.where: 4-way switch, top front of the grip, thumb

functions.text: IFF OUT: datalink symbols on FCR on/off
IFF IN: cycle FCR datalink filters
Send STPT / SPI / SEAD target by datalink

controls.name: MAN RNG/UNCAGE knob
controls.where: rotary knob with push, top of the grip, index finger

functions.text: HUD declutter: ILS bars and roll scale

controls.name: DOG FIGHT switch
controls.where: 3-position slide, outboard front of the grip, index finger

functions.text: Back to the previous master mode
MISSILE OVERRIDE: CRM radar in RWS

controls.name: ANT ELEV knob
controls.where: thumbwheel with centre detent, front of the grip

controls.name: RDR CURSOR/ENABLE control
controls.where: force-sensing cursor control, inboard side of the grip, thumb

functions.text: Step MAV mode PRE / VIS / BORE

controls.name: SPD BRK switch
controls.where: 3-position slide, inboard side of the grip, thumb; aft is momentary

functions.text: Extend speed brakes (hold aft past 43 deg)
Hold speed brakes where they are

controls.name: Throttle cutoff release
controls.where: trigger lever under the grip, fingers

functions.text: Lets the throttle pass IDLE to OFF (stop)

controls.name: Throttle
controls.where: single throttle above the left console; detents OFF, IDLE, MIL, MAX AB

functions.text: Thrust IDLE to MIL; afterburner beyond MIL
OFF to IDLE: fuel and ignition for start

panels.name: Integrated Control Panel (ICP)
panels.text: Up-front panel under the HUD: master modes, DED pages and data entry.

items.name: Override buttons COM 1 / COM 2 / IFF / LIST
items.text: Jump the DED to the UHF, VHF, IFF or LIST page.

items.name: Master mode buttons A-A / A-G
items.text: Select A-A or A-G; pressing the active one again returns to NAV.

items.name: SYM knob
items.text: HUD symbology brightness.

items.name: RET DEPR knob
items.text: Sets the manual bombing reticle depression, 0 to 260 mils.

items.name: Priority function / data entry keypad
items.text: Digits 1-9: from the CNI page open common DED pages; else type data.

items.name: RCL button
items.text: First press deletes the last digit, second press clears the entry.

items.name: ENTR button
items.text: Accepts the typed data into the selected DED field.

items.name: BRT knob
items.text: Raster brightness; no function in the Block 50.

items.name: CONT knob
items.text: Raster contrast; no function in the Block 50.

items.name: 0 / M-SEL button
items.text: Cycles options on DED pages; also enters 0 or a minus sign.

items.name: DED increment/decrement rocker
items.text: Steps the selected DED value up or down.

items.name: Data Control Switch (DCS, "dobber")
items.text: Moves the DED cursor, sequences fields, RTN goes back to CNI.

items.name: DRIFT C/O & WARN RESET switch
items.text: Cages the flight path marker in azimuth; WARN RESET clears HUD warnings.

panels.name: Left Eyebrow Lights
panels.text: Caution and fault buttons above the left MFD.

items.name: MASTER CAUTION button
items.text: Lights with any new caution light; press to reset it.

items.name: TF-FAIL warning light
items.text: No function in the Block 50.

items.name: F-ACK button
items.text: Acknowledges PFLD faults and clears them where possible.

items.name: IFF IDENT button
items.text: Sends a transponder identification of position (not Mode 4).

panels.name: Right Eyebrow Lights
panels.text: Split warning lights that need immediate action.

items.name: ENG FIRE warning light
items.text: Fire detected in the engine bay.

items.name: ENGINE warning light
items.text: Overtemp, flameout or stall: RPM below 60 % or FTIT above 1100 C.

items.name: HYD/OIL PRESS warning light
items.text: Low engine oil pressure or hydraulic system A or B below 1000 psi.

items.name: FLCS warning light
items.text: Flight control computer fault, failed FLCS BIT or locked LE flaps.

items.name: DBU ON warning light
items.text: FLCS runs on digital backup software.

items.name: TO/LDG CONFIG warning light
items.text: Low, slow and descending without gear down or full flaps; with horn.

items.name: CANOPY warning light
items.text: Canopy not down and locked.

items.name: OXY LOW warning light
items.text: Backup oxygen below 5 psi; also lit 10 s during the OBOGS BIT.

panels.name: AoA Indexer
panels.text: Three approach AoA lights left of the HUD.

items.name: Dimming lever
items.text: Dims the indexer lights.

items.name: High AoA light
items.text: AoA 14 deg or more: slow, losing energy.

items.name: Optimal AoA light
items.text: AoA 11 to 14 deg: on speed for landing.

items.name: Low AoA light
items.text: AoA 11 deg or less: fast.

panels.name: AR Status / NWS Indicator
panels.text: Refuelling and nosewheel steering lights right of the HUD.

items.name: Dimming lever
items.text: Dims the indicator lights.

items.name: RDY light
items.text: Air refuelling door open and ready.

items.name: AR/NWS light
items.text: In the air: boom latched. On the ground: nosewheel steering engaged.

items.name: DISC light
items.text: Boom disconnected; returns to ready after 3 s.

panels.name: Miscellaneous (MISC) Panel
panels.text: Emission control, armament and autopilot switches.

items.name: RF switch
items.text: Limits the aircraft emitters (radar, datalink, TACAN, radar altimeter).

items.name: ECM enable light
items.text: ECM pod is jamming.

items.name: LASER ARM switch
items.text: Arms the targeting pod laser.

items.name: ALT REL button
items.text: Backup for the stick weapon release button.

items.name: MASTER ARM switch
items.text: Weapon release on, off, or symbology only (SIMULATE).

items.name: ADV MODE button
items.text: Terrain following function; not used in the Block 50.

items.name: Autopilot PITCH and ROLL switches
items.text: Engage the autopilot and select its pitch and roll modes.

panels.name: Threat Warning Prime Control Panel
panels.text: RWR control buttons next to the threat azimuth indicator.

items.name: HANDOFF button
items.text: Selects the threat handoff mode on the azimuth indicator.

items.name: MODE button
items.text: Shows all threats (OPEN) or the highest priority ones.

items.name: LAUNCH button
items.text: Flashes MISSILE LAUNCH when a radar guides a missile.

items.name: TGT SEP button
items.text: Spreads overlapping threat symbols apart.

items.name: UNKNOWN button
items.text: Shows unidentified radars as U symbols.

items.name: SYS TEST button
items.text: Hold 1 s for an RWR self-test.

panels.name: Multifunction Displays (left and right MFD)
panels.text: Two MFDs with 20 option select buttons and four rockers each.

items.name: OSB 1-20
items.text: Option select buttons around the screen; pick formats and options.

items.name: GAIN rocker
items.text: Sensor video gain up/down.

items.name: SYM rocker
items.text: Symbology brightness up/down.

items.name: CON rocker
items.text: Contrast up/down.

items.name: BRT rocker
items.text: Display brightness up/down.

panels.name: Electronic Horizontal Situation Indicator (EHSI)
panels.text: Navigation display below the ADI.

items.name: CRS / brightness knob
items.text: Sets the course; also display brightness.

items.name: HDG knob
items.text: Sets the heading bug.

items.name: M (mode) button
items.text: Changes the EHSI navigation mode.

panels.name: Standby Attitude Indicator (SAI)
panels.text: Self-contained gyro attitude backup.

items.name: Attitude sphere
items.text: Blue sky / brown ground ball that shows pitch and roll.

items.name: Aircraft symbol
items.text: Fixed waterline reference; height set with the cage knob.

items.name: Bank angle pointer
items.text: Shows bank against the scale; level at the top index.

items.name: Bank angle scale
items.text: Marks at 10, 20, 30, 60 and 90 deg.

items.name: Pitch trim scale
items.text: Reference for the aircraft symbol pitch setting.

items.name: PULL TO CAGE knob
items.text: Pull to cage level (OFF flag); turn to set the symbol pitch.

panels.name: Attitude Director Indicator (ADI)
panels.text: Primary attitude instrument with ILS needles, fed by the INS.

items.name: Attitude sphere
items.text: Shows pitch and roll in all attitudes.

items.name: Upper bank angle pointer
items.text: Bank angle against the outer index.

items.name: Pitch scale
items.text: Pitch marks every 10 deg.

items.name: Glideslope deviation pointer
items.text: Glideslope position during an ILS approach.

items.name: Glideslope deviation scale
items.text: Above / below glideslope scale.

items.name: Aircraft symbol
items.text: Fixed nose reference.

items.name: OFF flag
items.text: No attitude data from the INS.

items.name: AUX flag
items.text: Degraded attitude data from the INS.

items.name: Lower bank angle scale
items.text: Bank angle scale at the bottom.

panels.name: Engine Instruments
panels.text: Engine gauges on the right of the instrument panel.

items.name: OIL pressure indicator
items.text: 0-100 psi; about 15 at ground idle, 60 at MIL in flight.

items.name: NOZ POS indicator
items.text: Exhaust nozzle opening in percent.

items.name: RPM indicator
items.text: Engine core speed, 0-110 %.

items.name: FTIT indicator
items.text: Fan turbine inlet temperature, 200-1200 C.

items.name: FUEL FLOW indicator
items.text: Engine fuel flow in pounds per hour.

panels.name: Airspeed / Mach Indicator
panels.text: Pitot-static airspeed and Mach instrument.

items.name: VNE pointer
items.text: Never-exceed speed, 800 kt at sea level.

items.name: Airspeed scale
items.text: Outer scale, 80 to 850 kt.

items.name: Mach window
items.text: Mach 0.5 to 2.2.

items.name: Airspeed pointer
items.text: Points at airspeed and Mach.

items.name: Airspeed reference index
items.text: Movable reference bug.

items.name: SET INDEX knob
items.text: Moves the reference index.

panels.name: Altimeter
panels.text: Barometric altimeter, electric (CADC) or pneumatic.

items.name: 1000 ft scale
items.text: Outer scale in 100 ft marks.

items.name: Pointer
items.text: Altitude on the 1000 ft scale.

items.name: PNEU flag
items.text: Altimeter in pneumatic mode (also after a CADC failure).

items.name: Altitude counter
items.text: Altitude in hundreds of feet.

items.name: Kollsman window
items.text: Altimeter setting in inHg (QNH).

items.name: Barometric setting knob
items.text: Sets the altimeter setting.

items.name: Mode switch
items.text: Hold to select electric or pneumatic mode.

panels.name: Angle-of-Attack (AoA) Indicator
panels.text: AoA tape left of the ADI.

items.name: AoA tape
items.text: -5 to +32 deg.

items.name: Current AoA marker
items.text: Present AoA.

items.name: High AoA region
items.text: 14 to 16.5 deg.

items.name: Optimal AoA region
items.text: 11 to 14 deg, on speed.

items.name: Low AoA region
items.text: 8.5 to 11 deg.

panels.name: Vertical Velocity Indicator (VVI)
panels.text: Climb / descent rate tape right of the ADI.

items.name: Vertical velocity tape
items.text: Plus/minus 6000 ft/min.

items.name: Current marker
items.text: Present climb or descent rate.

items.name: Climb region
items.text: Light-shaded part: climbing.

items.name: Descent region
items.text: Dark-shaded part: descending.

panels.name: FUEL QTY SEL Panel
panels.text: Fuel gauge selector and external tank order.

items.name: FUEL QTY SEL knob
items.text: Chooses the tanks shown by the fuel gauge needles; TEST checks the gauge.

items.name: EXT FUEL TRANS switch
items.text: Centerline tank first (NORM) or wing tanks first.

panels.name: Landing Gear Panel
panels.text: Gear, brakes, hook and stores switches on the left auxiliary console.

items.name: EMER STORES JETTISON button
items.text: Hold 1 s to jettison tanks and A-G stores.

items.name: HOOK switch
items.text: Lowers the arresting hook.

items.name: WHEELS down lights
items.text: Green: that gear leg is down and locked.

items.name: LG handle
items.text: Raises or lowers the gear; red light while in transit.

items.name: GND JETT ENABLE switch
items.text: Maintenance: allows arming and jettison on the ground.

items.name: BRAKES channel switch
items.text: Brake channel for the toe brakes; normally CHAN 1.

items.name: ANTI-SKID / PARKING BRAKE switch
items.text: Parking brake, anti-skid braking or anti-skid off.

items.name: DN LOCK REL button
items.text: Unlocks the gear handle if its solenoid fails.

items.name: STORES CONFIG switch
items.text: Sets FLCS limits for the loadout; CAT III for heavy or A-G loads.

items.name: HORN SILENCER button
items.text: Silences the gear and low-speed warning tones.

items.name: LANDING TAXI LIGHTS switch
items.text: Nose gear lights; off when the gear is up.

items.name: SPEED BRAKE position indicator
items.text: CLOSED, dots when open, stripes without power.

panels.name: HMCS Panel and ALT GEAR Handle
panels.text: Helmet symbology brightness and the backup gear release.

items.name: HMCS SYMBOLOGY INT knob
items.text: Helmet symbology brightness; OFF removes it.

items.name: ALT GEAR handle
items.text: Pull to lower the gear without hydraulics.

items.name: ALT GEAR reset button
items.text: Push to reset the alternate gear system.

panels.name: CMDS Control Panel
panels.text: Countermeasures dispenser control on the left auxiliary console.

items.name: Status displays
items.text: Dispenser status.

items.name: Quantity displays
items.text: Remaining chaff and flares; also failure messages.

items.name: RWR switch
items.text: Lets the CMDS use RWR threats in SEMI and AUTO.

items.name: O1 / O2 / CH / FL switches
items.text: Enable each expendable type.

items.name: JMR switch
items.text: No function.

items.name: MWS switch
items.text: No function.

items.name: JETT switch
items.text: Dispenses all expendables at once.

items.name: PRGM knob
items.text: Manual program for CMS forward; BIT tests the CMDS.

items.name: MODE knob
items.text: CMDS operating mode.

panels.name: Threat Warning Auxiliary Control Panel
panels.text: RWR power and display options.

items.name: SEARCH button
items.text: Shows search and early-warning radars as S symbols.

items.name: ACT/PWR button
items.text: POWER lamp when on; ACTIVITY when tracking radars are seen.

items.name: ALTITUDE button
items.text: Switches between high and low altitude threat tables.

items.name: POWER button
items.text: RWR power on/off.

items.name: DIM knob
items.text: Brightness of the RWR panel lights.

panels.name: Right Auxiliary Console Instruments
panels.text: Standby and system gauges right of the instrument panel.

items.name: Magnetic compass
items.text: Standby magnetic heading.

items.name: Pilot Fault List Display (PFLD)
items.text: Lists FLCS warnings and system cautions; clear with F-ACK.

items.name: FUEL quantity indicator
items.text: Totalizer plus AL and FR needles; red shows an imbalance.

items.name: HYD PRESS A and B indicators
items.text: Hydraulic pressure, normal 2850-3250 psi.

items.name: EPU fuel quantity indicator
items.text: Hydrazine left in percent; 100 % is 10-15 min of EPU.

items.name: Caution light panel
items.text: Caution lights for detected faults; triggers MASTER CAUTION.

items.name: Cabin pressure indicator
items.text: Cockpit pressure altitude in thousands of feet.

panels.name: Mechanical Clock
panels.text: 8-day wind-up clock.

items.name: Day hand
items.text: One turn is 8 days.

items.name: Hour hand
items.text: One turn is 12 hours.

items.name: Minute hand
items.text: One turn is 60 minutes.

items.name: Wind / set knob
items.text: Turn to wind; pull and turn to set the time.

panels.name: ENG & JET START Control Panel
panels.text: Jet fuel starter and engine control mode.

items.name: JFS RUN light
items.text: Jet fuel starter at governed speed.

items.name: JFS switch
items.text: Starts the JFS with one or both brake/JFS accumulators.

items.name: ENG CONT switch
items.text: Engine control: primary (DEC) or secondary mode.

items.name: AB RESET switch
items.text: Spring-loaded; engine data recording (not implemented).

items.name: MAX POWER switch
items.text: No function with the F110-GE-129 engine.

panels.name: EPU Control Panel
panels.text: Emergency power unit control.

items.name: EPU switch
items.text: EPU automatic (NORM) or manually on / off.

items.name: EPU run light
items.text: EPU running and its hydraulic pump above 2000 psi.

items.name: AIR light
items.text: EPU running on engine bleed air.

items.name: HYDRAZN light
items.text: EPU burning hydrazine.

panels.name: ELEC Control Panel
panels.text: Main power and generator status.

items.name: MAIN PWR switch
items.text: Selects aircraft electrical power source.

items.name: ELEC CAUTION RESET button
items.text: Clears ELEC cautions and resets the generators.

items.name: FLCS PMG light
items.text: FLCS not powered by its permanent magnet generator.

items.name: MAIN GEN light
items.text: No main generator or external power.

items.name: STBY GEN light
items.text: No standby generator power.

items.name: EPU GEN light
items.text: EPU commanded on but not powering the emergency buses.

items.name: EPU PMG light
items.text: EPU magnet generator not powering all FLCS branches.

items.name: ACFT BATT FAIL light
items.text: Battery failure (20 V or less).

items.name: ACFT BATT TO FLCS light
items.text: FLCS running on battery power.

panels.name: FUEL Control Panel
panels.text: Fuel master, pumps and air refuelling door.

items.name: FUEL MASTER switch
items.text: Main fuel shutoff valve; guarded, normally MASTER.

items.name: TANK INERTING switch
items.text: Pumps halon into the tanks against fire.

items.name: ENGINE FEED knob
items.text: Fuel pumps; AFT / FWD correct a fuel imbalance.

items.name: AIR REFUEL switch
items.text: Opens the refuelling door; slow speeds then use landing FLCS gains.

panels.name: AUDIO 1 & AUDIO 2 Control Panels
panels.text: Radio and tone volumes, squelch and intercom.

items.name: COMM 1 power/volume knob
items.text: UHF volume; full left turns UHF off.

items.name: COMM 1 mode knob
items.text: UHF squelch or guard 243.0.

items.name: COMM 2 power/volume knob
items.text: VHF volume; full left turns VHF off.

items.name: COMM 2 mode knob
items.text: VHF squelch or guard 121.5.

items.name: SECURE VOICE volume knob
items.text: No function.

items.name: MSL volume knob
items.text: AIM-9 seeker tone volume.

items.name: TF volume knob
items.text: No function.

items.name: THREAT volume knob
items.text: RWR tone volume.

items.name: INTERCOM volume knob
items.text: Intercom, warning tones and voice message volume.

items.name: TACAN volume knob
items.text: TACAN Morse identifier volume.

items.name: ILS power/volume knob
items.text: ILS identifier volume; OFF turns the ILS off.

items.name: HOT MIC CIPHER switch
items.text: Intercom / secure voice mode (not implemented).

panels.name: IFF Control Panel
panels.text: Backup IFF transponder control.

items.name: MASTER knob
items.text: AIFF transponder / interrogator mode.

items.name: M-4 CODE switch
items.text: Mode 4 crypto code handling (not implemented).

items.name: C & I knob
items.text: IFF and UHF controlled from the UFC or from the backup panels.

items.name: Enable switch
items.text: Backup mode code pair (not implemented).

items.name: MODE 1 & MODE 3 code wheels
items.text: Backup Mode 1 and Mode 3 codes with C & I in BACK UP.

items.name: MODE 4 REPLY switch
items.text: Mode 4 reply code (not implemented).

items.name: MODE 4 MONITOR switch
items.text: Tone for Mode 4 replies (not implemented).

panels.name: EXT LIGHTING Control Panel
panels.text: Exterior lights.

items.name: POSITION FLASH/STEADY switch
items.text: Position lights flashing or steady.

items.name: POSITION WING/TAIL switch
items.text: Wingtip, intake and tail position lights brightness.

items.name: FUSELAGE switch
items.text: Lights that illuminate the vertical tail.

items.name: ANTI-COLL knob
items.text: Anti-collision strobe off or one of 7 flash patterns.

items.name: FORM knob
items.text: Formation light brightness.

items.name: AERIAL REFUELING knob
items.text: Refuelling receptacle light brightness.

items.name: MASTER knob
items.text: Exterior lights master mode; overrides the switches above.

panels.name: FLT CONTROL Panel
panels.text: Flight control system backup, flaps and test.

items.name: DIGITAL BACKUP switch
items.text: Selects FLCS backup software (DBU ON light).

items.name: MANUAL TF FLY-UP switch
items.text: Terrain-following function; not used in the Block 50.

items.name: ALT FLAPS switch
items.text: Lowers trailing edge flaps manually.

items.name: FLCS RUN / FAIL lights
items.text: FLCS BIT running (green) or failed (red).

items.name: LE FLAPS switch
items.text: Locks the leading edge flaps (not implemented).

items.name: FLCS RESET switch
items.text: Resets FLCS warnings and failures.

items.name: FLCS BIT switch
items.text: Runs the flight control self-test on the ground (about 45 s).

panels.name: MANUAL TRIM Panel
panels.text: Manual trim wheels and trim / autopilot disconnect.

items.name: ROLL TRIM wheel and indicator
items.text: Roll trim and its position.

items.name: YAW TRIM knob
items.text: Rudder trim.

items.name: PITCH TRIM wheel and indicator
items.text: Pitch trim and its position.

items.name: TRIM/AP DISC switch
items.text: DISC: panel-only trim and no autopilot.

panels.name: TEST Panel
panels.text: System test switches.

items.name: FIRE & OHEAT DETECT test button
items.text: Tests fire and overheat detection lights.

items.name: OBOGS BIT switch
items.text: Tests the oxygen system (OXY LOW lights 10 s).

items.name: MAL & IND LTS test button
items.text: Lights all warning and caution lights, plays voice messages.

items.name: PROBE HEAT switch
items.text: Air data probe heat on the ground; test.

items.name: EPU/GEN test switch
items.text: Tests the EPU generator without hydrazine.

items.name: FLCS PWR lights A-D
items.text: Power to the four FLCS channels during the test.

items.name: FLCS PWR TEST switch
items.text: Tests FLCS power output.

panels.name: UHF Backup Control Panel
panels.text: ARC-164 UHF radio backup controls (C & I in BACK UP).

items.name: CHAN knob
items.text: Preset channel.

items.name: Manual frequency knobs
items.text: Five knobs for a manual frequency.

items.name: Function knob
items.text: Radio power and receiver mode.

items.name: Mode knob
items.text: Manual, preset or guard frequency.

items.name: TONE button
items.text: Sends a tone.

items.name: SQUELCH switch
items.text: Squelch on/off.

items.name: VOL knob
items.text: Volume.

items.name: TEST DISPLAY button
items.text: Tests the frequency display.

items.name: STATUS button
items.text: Shows the radio status.

panels.name: Canopy, MPO and DEFOG Controls
panels.text: Left console and left canopy rail controls.

items.name: MANUAL PITCH override switch
items.text: Hold OVRD for more stabilator authority in a deep stall.

items.name: Canopy switch
items.text: Raises or lowers the canopy (lever unlocked).

items.name: Canopy handle
items.text: Latches the canopy and its pressure seal.

items.name: CANOPY JETTISON T-handle
items.text: Jettisons the canopy in an emergency.

items.name: DEFOG lever
items.text: Moves airflow to the canopy to clear fog.

panels.name: SNSR PWR Control Panel
panels.text: Power for the main sensors.

items.name: LEFT HDPT switch
items.text: Powers the left chin pod (HARM targeting pod).

items.name: RIGHT HDPT switch
items.text: Powers the right chin pod (targeting pod).

items.name: FCR switch
items.text: Powers the APG-68 radar.

items.name: RDR ALT switch
items.text: Radar altimeter transmit, standby or off.

panels.name: HUD Control Panel
panels.text: HUD display options.

items.name: Scales switch
items.text: Airspeed, altitude, heading and VV scales.

items.name: Flightpath marker switch
items.text: Pitch ladder and flight path marker.

items.name: DED/PFLD data switch
items.text: Repeats DED or PFLD at the HUD bottom.

items.name: Depressible reticle switch
items.text: Manual bombing reticle.

items.name: Velocity switch
items.text: Speed shown on the HUD scale.

items.name: Altitude switch
items.text: Not implemented.

items.name: Brightness control switch
items.text: HUD brightness mode.

items.name: TEST switch

The guide notes the tables are not complete; see the sensor chapters. Panels from the cockpit chapter (pp. 43-82), HUD control panel and ICP (pp. 94-100), CMDS and RWR panels (pp. 695-698); MFD, EHSI and UHF backup items from the cockpit clickable names. BMS models a similar Block 50/52 HOTAS.

variants.cockpit: The first production F-16 cockpit: side-stick on the right console, throttle on the left, a 30-degree reclined seat. Instead of the later two MFDs it has a single radar/EO display and a stores control panel; the Block 15 OCU added the wide-angle HUD.
variants.notes: HOTAS from the Falcon BMS 4.38 Dash-34 hands-on control charts (p.58-62: one A-A chart for A-A, MSL OVRD and DGFT, one A-G chart that also covers NAV); SOI-dependent functions are rows with a "when". Differences to the DCS Block 50 table: COMM left/right drive the datalink, TMS left is IFF (short SCAN, long LOS), the trigger first detent does nothing in A-A, MAN RNG adjusts radar gain / TGP FOV in A-G and its long press selects the strafe gun. The real pre-MLU Block 10/15 had no SOI concept and no MFDs, so DMS / SOI rows apply to BMS (which draws an MLU-type pit) more than to the real jet. Panels: the real Block 15 cockpit from public descriptions (low): small HUD, radar/EO scope, stores control panel, round-dial instruments, CNI panels on the consoles.

variants.cockpit: The European A/B airframes rebuilt with a Block 50/52-standard cockpit: modular mission computer, ICP and DED, two MFDs and the same HOTAS as the C/D. Later tapes added targeting pods, JDAM, Link 16 and the JHMCS helmet sight.
variants.notes: HOTAS from the Falcon BMS 4.38 Dash-34 hands-on control charts (p.58-62: one A-A chart for A-A, MSL OVRD and DGFT, one A-G chart that also covers NAV); SOI-dependent functions are rows with a "when". Differences to the DCS Block 50 table: COMM left/right drive the datalink, TMS left is IFF (short SCAN, long LOS), the trigger first detent does nothing in A-A, MAN RNG adjusts radar gain / TGP FOV in A-G and its long press selects the strafe gun. The MLU gave the A/B a Block 50-style cockpit (ICP/DED, two MFDs, same HOTAS), so the pages are inherited from the Block 50; BMS ships the f16a_mlu layout. Differences: APG-66(V)2A radar, HMCS only on later tapes, RWR/ECM per air force (e.g. Belgian TASC).

variants.cockpit: The first C cockpit: up-front controls (ICP and DED) under a wide-angle HUD and two multifunction displays (monochrome green on the Block 25/30/32 as modelled in BMS). The Block 30/32 added AMRAAM and HARM integration; GE (30) and Pratt & Whitney (32) engines.
variants.notes: HOTAS from the Falcon BMS 4.38 Dash-34 hands-on control charts (p.58-62: one A-A chart for A-A, MSL OVRD and DGFT, one A-G chart that also covers NAV); SOI-dependent functions are rows with a "when". Differences to the DCS Block 50 table: COMM left/right drive the datalink, TMS left is IFF (short SCAN, long LOS), the trigger first detent does nothing in A-A, MAN RNG adjusts radar gain / TGP FOV in A-G and its long press selects the strafe gun. Cockpit pages are the Block 50 ones (BMS ships a Block 30 layout, f16c_b30, with the same panel set): green MFDs, no HMCS panel or EGI on the USAF Block 25/30/32 as built, no HTS. BMS also flies the IDF/AF Barak I and Egyptian and Korean Block 32.

variants.cockpit: The C/D cockpit with LANTIRN: a holographic wide-angle HUD that can show the navigation pod's FLIR picture, night-vision-goggle compatible lighting and colour MFDs on the upgraded CM jets. Otherwise the same layout as the Block 50: ICP and DED under the HUD, two MFDs, side-stick and throttle.
variants.notes: HOTAS from the Falcon BMS 4.38 Dash-34 hands-on control charts (p.58-62: one A-A chart for A-A, MSL OVRD and DGFT, one A-G chart that also covers NAV); SOI-dependent functions are rows with a "when". Differences to the DCS Block 50 table: COMM left/right drive the datalink, TMS left is IFF (short SCAN, long LOS), the trigger first detent does nothing in A-A, MAN RNG adjusts radar gain / TGP FOV in A-G and its long press selects the strafe gun. Cockpit pages are the Block 50 ones (BMS ships the f16c_b40 layout): Block 40/42 adds LANTIRN, so the TFR panel and DMS fwd hold snaplook apply; no HARM targeting pod. GE F110 (40) or P&W F100 (42). BMS: USAF CM/DM, IDF/AF Barak II, Egypt.

variants.cockpit: Two seats in tandem under a longer canopy; the front cockpit is the same as the single-seat C of the same block. The rear cockpit repeats the side-stick, throttle and main displays for an instructor or a weapon systems officer.
variants.notes: HOTAS from the Falcon BMS 4.38 Dash-34 hands-on control charts (p.58-62: one A-A chart for A-A, MSL OVRD and DGFT, one A-G chart that also covers NAV); SOI-dependent functions are rows with a "when". Differences to the DCS Block 50 table: COMM left/right drive the datalink, TMS left is IFF (short SCAN, long LOS), the trigger first detent does nothing in A-A, MAN RNG adjusts radar gain / TGP FOV in A-G and its long press selects the strafe gun. Front cockpit as the single-seat C of the same block (pages inherited from the Block 50). The rear seat has its own stick, throttle and displays (Dash-34 2.1.2 Aft Seat Controls); it is not described here.

variants.cockpit: Two-seat Block 52+ derivative for the Israeli Air Force: conformal fuel tanks, a dorsal spine, Israeli HUD, mission computer, digital map and DASH helmet sight. The rear cockpit is for the weapon systems navigator, with its own stick and throttle.
variants.notes: HOTAS from the Falcon BMS 4.38 Dash-34 hands-on control charts (p.58-62: one A-A chart for A-A, MSL OVRD and DGFT, one A-G chart that also covers NAV); SOI-dependent functions are rows with a "when". Differences to the DCS Block 50 table: COMM left/right drive the datalink, TMS left is IFF (short SCAN, long LOS), the trigger first detent does nothing in A-A, MAN RNG adjusts radar gain / TGP FOV in A-G and its long press selects the strafe gun. Cockpit pages inherited from the Block 50/52 (the Sufa is a Block 52+ two-seater); Israeli HUD, digital map and the Elisra SPS-3000 / IDIAS differ. CMS left/right drive the IDIAS jammer as in Dash-34 2.7.4.1.2. Rear (navigator) seat not covered.

variants.cockpit: UAE-funded development with the APG-80 AESA radar, an internal FLIR/laser targeting system and the Falcon Edge EW suite. The cockpit has three large colour displays and a helmet sight; side-stick and throttle stay where they are in every F-16.
variants.notes: Low confidence. HOTAS taken as the DCS Block 50 table (same grips); only the trigger first detent is changed for the internal FLIR/laser (IFTS). The cockpit pages describe the public layout (three 5x7 inch colour displays); exact switch sets are not public. Not flyable in DCS or BMS.

variants.cockpit: The newest F-16 standard (new-build Block 70/72 and upgrades such as Taiwan's F-16V): APG-83 AESA radar, a modernized mission computer, Auto-GCAS and the Center Pedestal Display under the glareshield. Side-stick, throttle and the up-front layout are those of the Block 50/52.
variants.notes: HOTAS and cockpit pages inherited from the DCS Block 50 (same grips and consoles). Differences: the large Center Pedestal Display (CPD) between the MFDs for map and sensor pictures, APG-83 AESA radar modes, Auto-GCAS. Medium for the layout, low for any Block 70-specific HOTAS change.

variants.cockpit: Single seat with a centre stick and two throttles on the left console. The UFC under the HUD, two DDIs and the AMPCD below them carry most of the work; the Lot 20 aircraft (as modelled in DCS) adds JHMCS, MIDS Link 16, ATFLIR/LITENING and the APG-73 radar.
variants.notes: DCS models a Lot 20 F/A-18C (~2005). HOTAS columns are the NAV / A-A / A-G master modes (EA guide pp.71-76, 168). Throttle figure 21 has no callout numbers; the throttle controls are numbered top to bottom. The radar knob EMERG position is from the cockpit, not the guide text.

variants.cockpit: The original Hornet cockpit that introduced the glass layout: UFC under the HUD, two DDIs and a centre map display, centre stick and two throttles. The A+ / MLU upgrades (Spain, Australia, Finland's C/D-level work) moved the A/B close to the C standard.
variants.notes: Stick and throttle as the DCS F/A-18C table, except: no MIDS positions on the COMM switch (no Link 16 as built), the RECCE button has no helmet function, AIM-120 only after the A+ / MLU upgrades. Cockpit pages inherited from the Lot 20 C: the early A has a horizontal indicator with projected map instead of the AMPCD and separate engine / fuel gauges instead of the IFEI. BMS flies the F-18A/B with its own 3D pit.

variants.notes: Stick and throttle inherited from the DCS F/A-18C (the Super Hornet keeps the Hornet grips; AESA / Block III specific assignments are not public). Front-panel pages from public descriptions (low); vertical panels and consoles as the C (medium). MSFS 2020/2024 fly a simplified E; War Thunder has the F/A-18E; BMS uses its Hornet pit.

variants.name: CF-18 Hornet (CF-188)
variants.cockpit: Canadian A/B Hornet with a night identification spotlight in the left gun loading door. The Incremental Modernization Project (2003-2010) gave it colour flat-panel displays, the APG-73 radar, new radios and mission computer, then Link 16 and the JHMCS helmet, close to the C/D standard.
variants.notes: Controls and cockpit pages as the C (inherited): after the Incremental Modernization Project the CF-188 has colour displays, APG-73, Link 16 (MIDS on the COMM switch) and JHMCS. As delivered it was an A/B (see F/A-18A/B). The night identification spotlight in the left gun-loading door is not covered. BMS and War Thunder fly the CF-188A.

variants.name: F/A-18F Super Hornet (Top Gun: Maverick, 2022)
variants.notes: The real two-seat F/A-18F as used in Top Gun: Maverick (2022): Navy pilots flew the aircraft from the front seat while the actors rode in the back seat, filmed by IMAX-certified cameras mounted in the cockpit. The film presents the actors as flying, so on screen the front-seat controls (stick, throttles) are those of the F/A-18F. The finale also shows an F-14 being flown.

variants.cockpit: Single seat in a titanium tub with a full-motion centre stick and two throttles on the left console. The Precision Engagement upgrade added two MFCDs, the UFC under the HUD and the CDU on the right console; most work is done through the sensor of interest picked with the coolie hat.
variants.notes: HOTAS from the manual's per-control SOI tables (p.88-92); short and long (1 s or more) presses differ. The paddle switch is not in this manual (A-10C II manual p.543). Radios: ARC-186 VHF/AM, ARC-164 UHF, ARC-186 VHF/FM. DCS 'A-10C' (Suite 3) module; War Thunder has an A-10C.

variants.cockpit: The A-10C with the Suite 7 software: Scorpion HMCS helmet sight, ARC-210 radio, new weapons (APKWS, GBU-54, GBU-38/31 updates) and an updated DSMS. Panels and hands-on controls are the A-10C's; the helmet becomes a sensor of interest.
variants.notes: HOTAS from the manual's stick (p.109) and throttle (p.112) tables per sensor of interest; short and long (1 s or more) presses differ. The CMS row follows the table (1 flare / 1 chaff / 6 flares / 6 chaff, programs on long presses), while the CMSP chapter (p.493, 496) says CMS forward starts and aft stops the program and left/right cycle programs. The paddle switch is not in the stick figure (p.543). Radio 1 is the ARC-210 in Suite 7; the manual has only its picture (p.167), its controls come from the cockpit tooltips. DCS 'A-10C II' module.

items.text: EXT STORES JETT: drops all stores on stations 1-11 (not TGP / ECM pod), any gear handle position.

panels.name: Standby Attitude Indicator

items.text: Shown when the gauge has no power or is caged.

items.name: Cage knob

items.name: Chaff-flare window
items.text: Chaff and flare counts, CMS mode letter and program.

items.name: MWS window
items.text: ACTIVE, LAUNCH or OFF.

items.name: SEP button
items.text: Spreads overlapping RWR symbols.

items.name: PRI button
items.text: RWR shows the 5 highest threats instead of 16.

items.name: UNK button
items.text: No function.

items.name: ML light
items.text: Flashes red on a detected missile launch.

panels.name: Attitude Director Indicator
panels.text: Primary attitude instrument with ILS / TISL / FM steering bars.

items.name: Attitude sphere
items.text: Sky / ground sphere with pitch marks and horizon line.

items.name: Miniature aircraft
items.text: Fixed W symbol showing pitch and roll against the sphere.

items.name: Bank scale and pointer
items.text: Bank marks at 10, 20, 30, 60, 90 deg with a white triangle pointer.

items.name: Turn and slip indicator
items.text: Slip ball in a tube with a turn-rate indicator below.

items.name: Pitch trim knob and index
items.text: Adjusts the miniature aircraft against the horizon.

items.name: Course warning flag
items.text: Shown in ILS / TACAN mode without a valid signal; stowed with the PTR switch.

items.name: Bank steering bar
items.text: Vertical bar: steer toward the HSI course, TISL target or FM station.

items.name: Pitch steering bar
items.text: Horizontal bar: glide slope, FM station or TISL target.

items.name: Glide slope warning flag
items.text: Shown when no ILS glide slope signal is received.

items.name: Glide slope scale and indicator
items.text: Chevron on a dot scale shows position against the glide slope.

items.name: Attitude warning flag (OFF)
items.text: Shown without power or while HARS fast erect is pressed.

panels.name: Horizontal Situation Indicator
panels.text: Heading, course and bearing instrument for steerpoints, TACAN and ADF.

items.name: Power OFF flag
items.text: Red flag when the HSI has no power.

items.name: Compass card
items.text: Rotating card; magnetic heading at the top.

items.name: Aircraft symbol
items.text: Fixed own-aircraft reference.

items.name: Lubber line
items.text: Fixed heading line to the top of the card.

items.name: Range indicator
items.text: Slant range in nm to the steerpoint or TACAN station.

items.name: Bearing pointer 2
items.text: Points to the current steerpoint.

items.name: Bearing pointer 1
items.text: Points to the TACAN station or UHF ADF station.

items.name: Heading set knob
items.text: Moves the heading marker around the card.

items.name: Heading marker
items.text: Selected heading bug on the card.

items.name: Bearing validity flag
items.text: Shown when the aircraft is far off course.

items.name: Course set knob
items.text: Sets the course arrow and course window.

items.name: Course selector window
items.text: Selected course in degrees.

items.name: Course arrow
items.text: Set course and its reciprocal on the card.

items.name: Course deviation indicator (CDI)
items.text: Shows lateral deviation from the set course.

items.name: To-From indicator
items.text: Triangles showing flight to or from the station or steerpoint.

panels.name: Navigation Mode Select Panel
panels.text: Selects the navigation source that drives the ADI, HSI and HUD; green triangle = active.

items.name: HARS button
items.text: HARS drives HSI, ADI and HUD (default after cold start).

items.name: EGI button
items.text: EGI / CDU navigation; needed for the TVV and full HUD symbology.

items.name: TISL button
items.text: Laser spot tracker angles drive the ADI steering bars.

items.name: STR PT button
items.text: HSI CDI set to the steerpoint.

items.name: ANCHR button
items.text: Navigation relative to the CDU anchor point.

items.name: TCN button
items.text: Navigation to the selected TACAN station.

items.name: ILS button
items.text: Glide slope on the ADI, localizer on the HSI.

items.name: UHF homing light
items.text: Amber when the UHF radio is in ADF mode.

items.name: VHF/FM homing light
items.text: Amber when the VHF/FM radio is in homing mode.

items.name: Pitch and roll bar switch (PTR)
items.text: Shows or stows the ADI steering bars and course warning flag.

panels.name: Right Front Dash
panels.text: Right part of the main panel: right MFCD, fuel and engine gauges, altimeter and VVI.

items.name: Fire extinguisher discharge switch
items.text: Fires the left or right bottle into the area of the pulled T-handle.

items.name: Right MFCD
items.text: Works like the left MFCD.

items.name: Fuel quantity and hydraulic indicator panel
items.text: Fuel quantity gauge, display selector and hydraulic pressures.

items.name: Right engine fire T-handle
items.text: Lights on a right engine fire; pull to aim the extinguisher there.

items.name: Marker beacon and canopy unlocked lights
items.text: MARKER BEACON over an ILS marker; CANOPY UNLOCKED while the canopy is open.

items.name: Vertical Velocity Indicator (VVI)
items.text: Climb / descent rate in feet per minute.

items.name: Altimeter
items.text: Barometric altitude.

items.name: Engine monitoring instruments
items.text: Oil pressure, core and fan speed, ITT, fuel flow and APU gauges.

panels.name: Fuel Quantity and Hydraulic Indicator Panel
panels.text: Fuel remaining per system and tank group plus both hydraulic pressures.

items.name: Fuel quantity gauge
items.text: Left / right pointers in 1000 lb per system; digital total fuel on top.

items.name: Fuel display selector
items.text: Selects which tanks the two pointers show.

items.name: Fuel gauge test button
items.text: While held, pointers go to 3 and the counter to 6,000.

items.name: Hydraulic pressure gauges
items.text: HYD SYS L and R in psi; normal 2,800-3,350.

panels.name: Altimeter
panels.text: Barometric altimeter with 100 ft pointer and counter.

items.name: Pressure set knob
items.text: Sets the barometric pressure.

items.name: ELECT / PNEU switch
items.text: Normal electric (CADC) or pneumatic mode; PNEU after a CADC failure.

panels.name: Engine Monitoring Instruments
panels.text: Engine and APU gauges on the lower right front dash.

items.name: Engine oil pressure indicators
items.text: Oil pressure of both engines (min 40, max 95 psi).

items.name: Engine core speed indicators
items.text: Core rpm in percent; do not exceed 102%.

items.name: Engine fan speed indicators
items.text: Fan rpm, about 82% at takeoff; the best thrust indication.

items.name: ITT indicators
items.text: Interstage turbine temperature; normal 275-865 C.

items.name: Engine fuel flow indicators
items.text: Fuel flow, normal 1,500-4,100 pph.

items.name: APU EGT indicator
items.text: APU exhaust temperature, normal 200-715 C.

items.name: APU rpm indicator
items.text: APU speed, normal 100%.

panels.name: HUD Area
panels.text: Above the front dash: HUD and UFC with the canopy-bow gauges and lights.

items.name: Standby compass
items.text: Magnetic compass on the right canopy bow.

items.name: Air refuel status lights
items.text: READY, LATCHED and DISCONNECT for boom refueling.

items.name: Heads Up Display (HUD)
items.text: Primary flight and weapon display.

items.name: Up Front Controller (UFC)
items.text: Keypad and rockers for data entry under the HUD.

items.name: Accelerometer (G-meter)
items.text: Current and peak G on the left canopy bow.

items.name: AoA indexer
items.text: Low / on / high speed symbols for landing; gear down only.

panels.name: Up Front Controller (UFC)
panels.text: Keypad under the HUD that repeats CDU and AAP functions for heads-up data entry.

items.name: MK button
items.text: Makes an overhead markpoint (CDU MK repeater).

items.name: CLR button
items.text: Deletes one scratchpad character; hold over 0.5 s to clear all.

items.name: HACK button
items.text: Toggles the hack time-to-target display on the HUD.

items.name: SPC button
items.text: Inserts a space in the scratchpads.

items.name: ALT ALRT button
items.text: Cycles AGL alert, MSL alert and MSL ceiling values on the HUD.

items.name: ENT button
items.text: Enters values and menu choices (elevation, hack time, Maverick boresight).

items.name: LTR button
items.text: Letter mode for the keys; press twice to lock.

items.name: FUNC button
items.text: Function mode: keys select CDU pages and AAP dial settings.

items.name: DATA rocker
items.text: Changes values: target elevation, hack time; CDU PG in function mode.

items.name: SEL rocker
items.text: HUD test menus, weapon profiles, gun reticles, A-A threat.

items.name: STEER rocker
items.text: Next / previous steerpoint (AAP STEER repeater).

items.name: INTEN rocker
items.text: HUD brightness.

items.name: DEPR rocker
items.text: Moves the depressible pipper from +10 to -300 mils.

items.name: MASTER CAUTION light / button
items.text: Lights with a new caution; press to reset it to steady.

items.name: Number keys 0-9
items.text: Digits; letters in LTR mode; CDU / AAP functions in FUNC mode.

items.text: Boost pumps, tank switches, crossfeed and air refuel.

items.name: Throttles panel
items.text: Throttles, APU and engine switches.

items.name: LASTE control panel
items.text: EAC, radar altimeter and autopilot mode.

items.name: VHF/AM radio panel
items.text: VHF/AM radio 1 (ARC-186, ARC-210 in Suite 7).

items.text: UHF radio.

items.text: VHF/FM radio.

items.text: Voice encryption.

items.name: Emergency brake handle

items.text: Indexer, NVIS, test and fire detect controls.

items.text: Transponder.

items.text: Emergency trim and control disengage switches.

items.name: Intercom control panel
items.text: Audio and transmitter selection.

items.name: Stall warning control panel
items.text: Stall tone volumes.

panels.name: Fuel System Control Panel
panels.text: Boost pumps, external tanks, crossfeed and air refuelling controls.

items.name: Main boost pump switches (L / R)
items.text: Boost pumps of the left and right main tanks.

items.name: Wing boost pump switches (L / R)
items.text: Boost pumps of the left and right wing tanks.

items.name: External tank switches (WING / FUS)
items.text: Enable transfer from wing and centre external tanks.

items.name: Crossfeed switch
items.text: Links both fuel systems so each pump feeds both engines.

items.name: Tank gate switch
items.text: Opens the valve between the left and right main tanks.

items.name: Air refuel control lever (RCVR)
items.text: Opens or closes the refuelling slipway door.

items.name: Fill disable buttons
items.text: Pull to stop refill of the left/right main or wing tank.

items.name: RCVR LT dial
items.text: Slipway and engine nacelle flood light brightness.

items.name: Line check button
items.text: No function in DCS.

items.name: Signal amplifier switch
items.text: No function in DCS.

panels.name: Throttles Panel
panels.text: Split throttle quadrant with APU and engine switches.

items.name: APU switch
items.text: Starts the APU (battery on): fuel pump, valve, starter, APU gauges.

items.name: Throttles
items.text: One lever per engine; OFF to IDLE starts the engine, IDLE-MAX sets thrust.

items.name: Engine fuel flow switches (L / R)
items.text: OVERRIDE bypasses the ITT limiter after an amplifier failure.

items.name: Engine operate switches (L / R)
items.text: IGN: manual ignition; MOTOR: purge fuel / restart with APU.

items.name: Landing gear horn silence button
items.text: Silences the gear warning horn.

panels.name: LASTE Control Panel
panels.text: EAC, radar altimeter and low altitude autopilot controls behind the throttles.

items.name: EAC switch
items.text: Arms enhanced attitude control (autopilot, PAC).

items.name: Radar altimeter switch
items.text: Enables the radar altimeter and GCAS.

items.name: Autopilot mode switch
items.text: LAAP mode: flight path, altitude and heading, or altitude and bank hold.

items.name: Autopilot engage/disengage button
items.text: Engages the selected autopilot mode, or disengages it.

panels.name: AN/ARC-210 Radio
panels.text: VHF/UHF radio replacing the ARC-186 VHF/AM radio 1 in Suite 7 (manual: to be documented; controls from the cockpit tooltips).

items.name: Master switch
items.text: Radio power and operating mode.

items.name: Channel select knob
items.text: Preset channel.

items.name: Secondary switch
items.text: Frequency source (manual, preset, guard ...).

items.name: 100 MHz selector
items.text: Frequency digit.

items.name: 10 MHz selector
items.text: Frequency digit.

items.name: 1 MHz selector
items.text: Frequency digit.

items.name: 100 kHz selector
items.text: Frequency digit.

items.name: 25 kHz selector
items.text: Frequency digits.

items.name: Function select keys (upper, middle, lower)

items.name: Offset frequency button
items.text: Frequency offset.

items.name: TX/RX function toggle
items.text: Transmit / receive function.

items.name: AM/FM select button
items.text: Modulation.

items.name: Menu pages button
items.text: Display menu pages.

items.name: Squelch button
items.text: Squelch on / off.

items.name: Brightness buttons
items.text: Display brightness up / down.

panels.name: AN/ARC-164 UHF Radio
panels.text: UHF radio, 225.000-399.975 MHz, 20 presets.

items.name: Preset channel selector
items.text: Selects one of 20 preset channels.

items.name: Preset channel window
items.text: Shows the preset channel number.

items.name: Frequency status window
items.text: Shows the active frequency.

items.name: 100 MHz selector
items.text: Sets the 100 MHz digit.

items.name: 10 MHz selector
items.text: Sets the 10 MHz digit (0-9).

items.name: 1 MHz selector
items.text: Sets the 1 MHz digit (0-9).

items.name: 0.1 MHz selector
items.text: Sets the tenths digit (0-9).

items.name: 0.025 MHz selector
items.text: Sets the last two digits.

items.name: Frequency mode dial
items.text: Manual frequency, preset channel or guard.

items.name: Function dial
items.text: Off, transceiver, transceiver plus guard, ADF (not functional).

items.name: Volume knob
items.text: UHF audio volume.

items.name: T-Tone button
items.text: No function in DCS.

items.name: Squelch switch
items.text: Squelch tone.

items.name: Load preset cover and button
items.text: Under the cover: LOAD stores the manual frequency to the selected preset.

panels.name: AN/ARC-186 VHF/FM Radio 2
panels.text: VHF/FM radio, 30.000-76.000 MHz, 20 presets; usually for JTAC.

items.name: Preset channel selector wheel
items.text: Selects the preset channel.

items.name: Preset channel window
items.text: Shows the preset channel.

items.name: Frequency selector knobs
items.text: Four knobs for the frequency digits.

items.name: LOAD button
items.text: Stores the manual frequency to the shown preset.

items.name: Volume knob
items.text: Radio volume.

items.name: Frequency mode dial
items.text: Off, transmit/receive, or direction finding (not functional).

items.name: Frequency selection dial
items.text: Guard channel, manual frequency or preset.

items.name: Squelch switch
items.text: Squelch / tone.

panels.name: KY-58 Secure Voice Panel
panels.text: Voice encryption for the UHF and VHF radios; not functional in DCS.

items.name: Power switch
items.text: Turns voice encryption on.

items.name: Mode dial
items.text: Operate, load keys, or receive keys by radio.

items.name: Radio select dial
items.text: Encrypt UHF, no encryption, or encrypt VHF.

items.name: Code preset dial
items.text: One of six crypto code presets.

items.name: Delay switch
items.text: No function in DCS.

items.name: Zeroize switch
items.text: Under a guard: erases the six crypto variables.

panels.name: Emergency Brake Handle
panels.text: Emergency wheel brakes after a left hydraulic failure.

items.name: EMER BRAKE handle
items.text: Brakes from the right hydraulic system or the accumulator (about five applications).

panels.name: Auxiliary Lighting Control Panel
panels.text: Indexer and NVIS lights, lamp test, HARS/SAS override and fire detect test.

items.name: Refuel status and indexer lights dial
items.text: Brightness of the AoA indexer and refuel status lights.

items.name: NVIS lights switch
items.text: Night-vision compatible lights; no function in DCS.

items.name: Signal light test button
items.text: Hold to test the warning and indicator lights.

items.name: Weapon station dimmer dial
items.text: No function in the A-10C.

items.name: HARS/SAS override switch
items.text: OVERRIDE keeps SAS on despite bad HARS data.

items.name: Fire detect / bleed air leak test button
items.text: Tests fire detection; the T-handles light.

panels.name: SAS Panel
panels.text: Stability augmentation channels and trim.

items.name: Yaw trim knob
items.text: Yaw trim bias with SAS on.

items.name: T/O TRIM button and light
items.text: Sets all trim to takeoff; TAKEOFF TRIM light when done.

items.name: Pitch SAS engage switches
items.text: Both up engage the two pitch SAS channels.

items.name: Yaw SAS engage switches
items.text: Both up engage the two yaw SAS channels.

items.name: Monitor test switch
items.text: No function in DCS.

panels.name: IFF/SIF Control Panel
panels.text: Transponder modes and codes; not functional in DCS.

items.name: Master mode dial
items.text: IFF power and receiver sensitivity.

items.name: M-1 switch
items.text: Mode 1 reply.

items.name: M-2 switch
items.text: Mode 2 reply.

items.name: M-3/A switch
items.text: Mode 3/A reply.

items.name: M-C switch
items.text: Mode C (altitude) reply.

items.name: Radiation test monitor switch
items.text: No function.

items.name: Identification of position switch
items.text: No function.

items.name: Mode 1 code wheels
items.text: Two-digit Mode 1 code (00-73).

items.name: Mode 3/A code wheels
items.text: Four-digit Mode 3/A code (digits 0-7).

items.name: Mode 4 switch
items.text: Encrypted Mode 4 reply.

items.name: Audio / light switch

items.name: Code dial
items.text: No function.

items.name: Reply light
items.text: Lights when replying to Mode 4.

items.name: Test light
items.text: Lights during a mode test.

panels.name: Emergency Flight Control Panel
panels.text: Emergency trim, retract and control-surface disengage switches.

items.text: EMER OVERRIDE moves trim to the emergency pitch/roll switch.

items.name: Speed brake emergency retract
items.text: Up: speed brakes close by air load.

items.name: Flap emergency retract
items.text: Up: flaps close by air load.

items.name: Aileron emergency disengage
items.text: Disengages a jammed left or right aileron actuator.

items.name: Elevator emergency disengage
items.text: Disengages a jammed left or right elevator actuator.

items.name: MRFCS switch
items.text: Manual reversion after a dual hydraulic failure.

panels.name: Intercom Control Panel
panels.text: Master audio panel: monitor switches and the transmitter selector.

items.name: Volume knob
items.text: Master volume for all audio.

items.name: HM (hot mic) button
items.text: Talks to ground crew / tanker (INT selected).

items.name: INT switch

items.name: AIM switch
items.text: AIM-9 seeker tone.

items.name: FM switch

items.name: VHF switch

items.name: ILS switch

items.name: UHF switch

items.name: TCN switch

items.name: Rotary selector dial

items.name: IFF switch
items.text: Interrogation tone volume.

items.name: Call switch
items.text: No function.

panels.name: Stall Warning Control Panel
panels.text: Volumes of the stall warning tones.

items.name: STALL volume dial
items.text: Volume of the chopped tone (1 unit or less from stall).

items.name: PEAK PRFM volume dial
items.text: Volume of the steady tone (2 units from stall); can go to zero.

panels.text: Electrical, environment, lighting and navigation panels on the right console.

items.name: Environment system panel

items.name: Lighting control panel
items.text: Exterior and cockpit lighting.

items.text: Caution annunciators.

items.text: Navigation data entry.

items.name: TACAN control panel
items.text: TACAN mode and channel.

items.name: ILS control panel

items.text: Helmet sight power.

items.text: Cockpit pressure altitude.

items.text: Console panel lighting.

variants.cockpit: The original A-10 cockpit: analog instruments, a HUD, a small TV monitor for the Maverick and a Pave Penny laser spot tracker; LASTE (early 1990s) added a weapon computer, autopilot and ground collision warning. The stick grip came from the F-4 Phantom; the left throttle is the one the A-10C kept.
variants.notes: Low confidence. DCS's A-10A is a Flaming Cliffs (simplified) module: its commands are generic (weapon cycle, countermeasures, ECM, sensor zoom) and not tied to the real switches; the functions above are those JoyPro maps to a physical A-10-style stick and throttle. The real A-10A stick and throttle switch list (TO 1A-10A-1) was not available; mic switch, boat switch and pinky switch of the shared left throttle are left out because their A-10A use is not documented here. BMS flies A-10A and A-10C both with this A-10A cockpit; War Thunder has the A-10A and A-10A Late.

variants.cockpit: Single-seat bubble canopy with a conventional centre stick and two throttles on the left console. The HUD and the radar display (VSD) top left are the main interface; the original analogue instruments remain on the A, MSIP aircraft add a colour multipurpose display.
variants.notes: The HOTAS of the F-15 was one of the first complete ones; the A and C share the layout, MSIP aircraft changed some details. Which grip (left or right throttle) carries each switch is not stated in the sources used, so the positions say 'on the throttle grips'. DCS Flaming Cliffs simplifies the radar controls (no EWWS, no gun camera); the countermeasures switch follows the DCS bindings. The DCS Flaming Cliffs manual has no HOTAS chapter (keyboard commands only) and no clickable cockpit; grip functions follow the real F-15C grip (r1) and the manual's radar/weapon chapters. Panels = the instrument figures of the manual.

variants.cockpit: Front seat of the two-seat strike fighter: HUD and up-front control, two MPDs and an MPCD, a centre stick and twin throttles. The pilot commands displays and sensors with the castle switch on the stick and the coolie, TDC and boat switches on the throttle.
variants.notes: Columns = sensor / display in command (HUD and NAV / A/A radar / A/G radar / targeting pod), from the manual's HOTAS sections (A/A radar p.314-318, A/G radar p.397-398, LANTIRN p.430-431, HUD p.147-148, NAV p.197). TSD and NAV FLIR HOTAS functions are not in the module yet and are left out. Coolie right (NCTR / EID) is not in the manual; from Chuck's Guide (r1). The manual has no figure numbers; panel items follow its numbered lists.

variants.cockpit: Rear cockpit with four displays and two sensor hand controllers on the consoles; the WSO also has a stick and throttles to fly the jet. The LHC works the left displays, the RHC the right ones, each with castle, coolie, TDC, trigger, auto acquisition switch and laser button.
variants.notes: The WSO HOTAS are the two hand controllers: the LHC (left displays, countermeasures) is listed on the throttle side, the RHC (right displays, AAI / NCTR) on the stick side next to the rear stick, whose trigger is fixed. LHC and RHC switches are mirrored; JoyPro's DCS mapping uses the LHC functions, so RHC rows carry no function id. Columns = sensor on the display in command (manual p.319-320, 399-400, 432-433). RHC switch aft (NCTR / EID) is from Chuck's Guide (r1). TSD functions are not in the module yet.

variants.cockpit: Tandem two-seat cockpit; the pilot has a centre stick and twin throttles with the wing-sweep switch, the RIO behind him runs radar, navigation and countermeasures. Analogue instruments with a HUD and the VDI in front of the pilot.
variants.notes: From the Heatblur F-14 manual (cockpit chapter, pilot). The target designate switch changes with the master mode (A/G: HUD designator, else pilot radar modes VSL HI / VSL LO / PAL); in the F-14B(U) it steps through TWS tracks unless the ACM cover is up. Volume panel shown in the F-14B / A late layout (the early A has ALR-45/50 knobs). Throttle afterburner and flap lever are not HOTAS switches; they are listed on the throttle quadrant panel. The ICS PTT direction order is not given in the manual (listed as positions).

variants.cockpit: Rear cockpit without flight controls: the RIO works the AWG-9 radar with the hand control unit under the TID, the LANTIRN pod with a fixed stick on the left console, and transmits with two foot buttons.
variants.notes: From the Heatblur F-14 manual (RIO cockpit chapter, HCU p.376-379, LANTIRN p.424-427). Modes are the four HCU function buttons: the HCU stick only moves the sensor or cursor while the trigger is held at half action. JoyPro shows the HCU on the stick side and the fixed LANTIRN stick on the throttle side; the LANTIRN panel side (right console) is read from a Chuck's Guide picture. The chaff/flare hat directions follow JoyPro's seed (inboard = right on the left hat).

variants.notes: The real F-14A as flown in the film Top Gun (1986): Navy F-14As of the Pacific Fleet flew the aerial scenes, with cameras inside the cockpits and on external mounts; the 'MiG-28' adversaries were F-5s. Maverick sits in the pilot's seat, Goose is the RIO in the back seat. Controls are those of the F-14A; what the film shows (stick trigger, pickle button, throttles) matches the real aircraft.

variants.cockpit: Tandem two-seat cockpit: the pilot in front with a centre stick, twin throttles and an optical sight, analogue instruments around a radar repeater. Weapon type is chosen with the pinky switch on the throttle, radar lock is the WSO's job.
variants.notes: From the Heatblur F-4E manual (pilot cockpit chapter p.39-183, stick p.180-181, throttles p.108-112, Maverick/AIM-9 use p.668, 698-699). A/G vs A/A rows: ARR button (AIM-9 self-track vs Maverick slew/lock), trigger (missiles/gun vs TV weapon video/uncage), NWS button in the air (radar auto-acquisition vs TV focus), FHC slews Mavericks only. Some position labels (sight mode, nose/tail arming, engine start) are short forms of the manual's descriptions.

variants.cockpit: Rear cockpit with a radar scope in the middle, the antenna hand control on the right console and a stick and throttles to fly the jet. The WSO locks targets, works the WRCS and the Pave Spike pod.
variants.notes: From the Heatblur F-4E manual (WSO cockpit chapter p.184-284; antenna hand control p.261, 487-488; Pave Spike trigger cycle p.563-573; Maverick p.698-699). Modes = what the antenna hand control drives: radar (A/A), Pave Spike pod (track mode by a half-action cycle, laser by a full-action cycle) or a TV weapon. The WSO dispense button is on the CCU panel, not on the rear throttle (fixed: panel.button.dispense). The rear throttles have only the speed brake and mic switches.

variants.cockpit: Small single-seat cockpit with a centre stick and two throttles, analogue instruments, a small radar scope and an optical sight. Radar range and TDC sit on a panel next to the throttles, the dogfight modes on the stick.
variants.notes: Modes are the AN/ASG-31 sight / AN/APQ-159 radar modes (sight mode selector plus the stick dogfight switch). Bomb-rocket button in DG mode: manual says DG overrides normal release circuits; no own function stated. Item lists from manual figures 4.1-4.8 and system chapters; panel item positions partly from cockpit tooltips.

variants.cockpit: Tandem two-seat combat trainer of the F-5E with a longer nose, one M39 gun and the same basic controls in both seats.
variants.notes: Front cockpit, HOTAS and panels inherited from the DCS F-5E-3. Differences: one M39 gun instead of two, longer nose; most F-5Fs keep the radar. The rear seat has its own stick and throttles; not covered. Not flyable in the supported games.

variants.cockpit: Simple first-generation F-5 cockpit without radar: centre stick, two throttles and an optical sight.
variants.notes: Low confidence: grip and console layout inferred from the F-5E family (DCS F-5E-3 manual) and public F-5A descriptions; the A has no radar, so no dogfight switch, no radar panel and no sight cage. War Thunder flies the F-5A with simplified controls.

variants.cockpit: Single-seat V/STOL cockpit with HUD, two colour displays and an up-front control. The left hand works both the throttle and the nozzle lever next to it; in the hover the stick drives reaction control jets in the nose, tail and wingtips.
variants.notes: Stick and throttle numbers follow the pocket guide figures (p.13-16); the Harrier manual numbers them differently (stick 1-8, throttle grip 1-9, p.122-125). Panels from the Harrier manual chapter 3 (numbered text, no figure captions), the ACP from the pocket guide. Mode cells left empty where the manuals name no function (e.g. trigger and pickle in NAV / VSTOL). TPOD HOTAS rows come from Chuck's guide because the pocket guide TPOD HOTAS page is blank. DCS models the Night Attack (no radar): antenna elevation and A/A programming have no function.

variants.cockpit: Glass cockpit without a HUD: one wide touch-screen display, helmet-mounted symbology and a side-stick / throttle HOTAS. Pilots describe the cockpit as having only about ten real switches.
variants.notes: Low confidence: HOTAS switch layout not public; stick, trigger, weapon release and throttle only (inferred). Panels from public descriptions. The A has the internal GAU-22/A gun. Not flyable in the supported games.

variants.cockpit: Very small single-seat cockpit: centre stick, one throttle with the flap lever next to it, analogue instruments around a small radar scope.
variants.notes: Controls follow the Community A-4E-C mod bindings (stick: trim, bomb release, gun-rocket trigger, NWS, AFCS disconnect; throttle grip: mic, exterior lights, speedbrake). Switch layouts varied between sub-models (A to M); the A-4F/M differences are not verified. Speedbrake directions assumed. Panels and the trigger / bomb button split by function selector from public A-4E/F NATOPS knowledge, no manual on this PC (medium / low).
